description: Generate and save a mind map from a notebook’s sources. RPC-backed (no browser). Returns the saved mind-map id and its JSON structure.

focus.description: Optional prompt steering what the mind map emphasises.

language.description: Language of the mind-map nodes (BCP-47 code or language name). Defaults to NOTEBOOKLM_CONTENT_LANGUAGE, or English.

title.description: Optional title for the saved mind map.

name: generate_mind_map

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
